This instant criminal misc. petition has been filed by the petitioners for quashing of FIR No.228/2022, PS Mahila Thana (Jodhpur City East), District Jodhpur for offence under Sections 498-A, 406 & 323 of IPC on the basis of compromise entered between the parties.
Counsel for the parties submit that the petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2/complainant are husband and wife.

They have [2023/RJJD/011479] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-398/2023] entered into a compromise in the spirit of Lok Adalat and settled their dispute amicably, therefore, the criminal proceedings offence under Sections 498-A, 406 & 323 of IPC may be quashed on the basis of Shahrukh Khan vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/011479) on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124999207/
1 compromise.

sentences.text: Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675 in which it has been held that the proceedings under Section 498A IPC can be quashed because it is the matrimonial matter, the criminal proceedings for offence under Sections 498-A, 406 & 323 of IPC are liable to be quashed.

entities.text: B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana, reported in 2003 (4) SCC p.675

Stay Petition is also decided accordingly.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: Having considered the facts and circumstances of the case, since the petitioner and complainant have arrived at compromise and settled their dispute and in the view of the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex court in the case of B.S. opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed and the criminal proceedings in FIR No.228/2022, PS Mahila Thana (Jodhpur City East), District Jodhpur for offence under Sections 498-A, 406 & 323 of IPC against the petitioners are hereby quashed on the basis of compromise deed.
Stay Petition is also decided accordingly.
